description: On the green cloth in front are piles of colorful beads, a black tape dispenser, a short red string, and a purple-and-white beaded strand. The left hand holds the black cord end over the strand, while the right hand pinches a small white bead from the pile and guides it onto the cord; then the right hand briefly moves right to pick up another bead and returns to press it down along the cord as the left hand steadies and keeps the cord aligned.
